description: Search fashion products on Realry.com. Put only the product itself in `query`, as a short noun phrase ("running shoes", "linen dress", "crossbody bag"), and put gender, price_min/price_max, colors, brand, sale_only/min_discount in their own parameters; use `category` only when the shopper asked for a whole category or the product type is ambiguous. `query` is matched against product text, so sentences and extra words ("for a wedding", "under $100", "cheap", "women's") make it miss. Bad: {"query": "women's black linen summer dress under $100"} Good: {"query": "linen dress", "gender": "women", "colors": "black", "price_max": 100} Good: {"query": "patagonia fleece", "brand": "Patagonia"} Returns product name, price, discount info, seller, and links. Use the Product ID with get_price_comparison to compare prices across all stores. When every store's stock is unconfirmed for 5+ days, those results are listed after fresher ones, so rank is not strict price order under price sorts.

brand.description: Brand name or slug, e.g. "Nike", "new-balance". Also keep the brand in query together with the model (query "le labo santal 33", brand "Le Labo"): an unknown brand is dropped, and query then still finds it.

category.description: Top-level category. Set it only when the shopper asked for a whole category ("show me bags") or query alone is ambiguous; leave it unset when query already names the product type. ACC = accessories, jewellery, watches, eyewear, hats, fragrance and beauty.

colors.description: Colour filter, English colour names, comma-separated (e.g. "black" or "black,white"). Use this instead of putting the colour in query.

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

gender.description: Who the item is for. Use this instead of writing "women's"/"men's" in query.

min_discount.description: Minimum discount percentage (e.g. 30 for 30% off or more)

price_max.description: Maximum price in the market currency for `country` (USD for US, GBP for GB, EUR for euro markets, JPY for JP, KRW for KR). Put shopper-stated limits here (e.g. "under $100"), not in query.

price_min.description: Minimum price in the market currency for `country` (USD for US, GBP for GB, EUR for euro markets, JPY for JP, KRW for KR). Put shopper-stated limits here (e.g. a floor of $50), not in query.

query.description: The product as a short noun phrase, 1-4 words (e.g. "sneakers", "wool coat", "air force 1"). No gender, price, colour or filler words — use the other parameters. When the shopper named a brand, keep it in query too and also set `brand`.

sort.description: Sort order. Omit for best match (default). "new" (newest), "likes" (most liked), "views" (most viewed), "sales" (highest discount), "pricelow" (cheapest first), "pricehigh" (most expensive first).
